body:
**[comments] Rule 2, restates identifiers: shorten**

Replaces lines 1881-1884 only (lines 1873-1880 are unchanged context). Sentences 2 and 3 restate the `!k_vnni::layout_on` operand and item 2 of Note [K VNNI storage], which also holds the 'temporary until the VNNI AMX kernel lands' fact, so one pointer to that item keeps the one fact the names lack (the AMX kernel needs row-major K).

Proposed:
```cpp
      // A VNNI slot has no row view for qk_rowmajor_128x4 to read (item 2 of
      // Note [K VNNI storage] in kv_cache.hpp).
```
